DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER_EPOCH_1.title: A Distorted Legacy
DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER_EPOCH_1.description:
On their first arrival, the traveler only meant to record how this world made barren matter grow again, how fragile lives kept fighting.

They confined transformation to their own hands, believing that no one could see through a veil beyond understanding.

Neow and another, unnamed ancient crossed that veil. They did not see a method, only a few broken rules: change could be urged onward, spread outward, and happen again.

Later, the Spire used its own knowledge to assemble those fragments into the Blight. The traveler gave no recipe, yet failed to keep observation on the side that was being observed.

DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER_EPOCH_2.title: The Choice of a Spark
DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER_EPOCH_2.description:
When the Blight ran wild, the ancients did not wait for the traveler to decide their fate.

They imprisoned Neow, hid those who could still survive, and kept the last order alive upon a dying land. Some waited. Some only tried to keep the companion before them alive. Not every life understood continuance in the same way.

When the traveler returned, the Blight had already become entangled with the Architect, the last tree, and the conditions that still allowed the world to endure. To erase it outright would have broken the remaining anchors as well.

So the traveler did not decide the world's ending. They only kept the final spark from going out, so that those who wished to live could continue to choose.

DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER_EPOCH_3.title: Those Who Remained
DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER_EPOCH_3.description:
A thousand years later, the Spire opened again. The traveler saw that the broken rules no longer belonged to a single act of trespass.

They had been used, misread, and amended by the lives of this world. They hid in repeated outcomes, effects that crossed their bounds, and costs made larger than before. No one could claim their origin alone.

The Blight still showed an erroneous echo near the vessel. Yet it could neither understand the traveler nor obey them. Old consequences had not vanished merely because time had passed.

The traveler did not reclaim the rules. They left a limited observer to record the changes those rules would bring, leaving the choice of any future answer to the future rather than to a moment of judgment.
